visual_review.notes: Reviewed every clip frame by frame. The walk is a continuous-step retake that follows the painted step-together carrying gait: feet together, then a wide step out, looped over 19-70 with every plate clean. The first walk retakes stood still or darkened the plate on each stomp. The hit is retaken so the poker stays cold instead of glowing, and the defend is retaken with one steady furnace glow because the first take pulsed the plate. The cast drops frames 23-24, where the raised poker smears into a stub. Idle, attack and death are used as generated.
